text: And I gave them one Parthian shot as I turned away. "The last prize-fight I saw was in a sort of souteneur's cabaret in the Avenue des Tilleuls," I sweetly explained to them. "But that was nearly three years ago. So if there is going to be a bout in my back yard, I trust you gentlemen will be so good as to call me!" And smiling up into their somewhat puzzled faces, I turned on my heel and went into the house.
